# Content packs

The snapshot of approved questions the shows are served from: what is in force, coverage by topic, what changed in the bank since, the next pack, and the history.

[PackStatus](#packstatus) · [PackCoverage](#packcoverage) · [PackDiffList](#packdifflist) · [PackBuilder](#packbuilder) · [PackHistory](#packhistory) · [TopicManager](#topicmanager)

### PackStatus

The pack that is being served: its revision, who made it and when, how many questions and topics it holds, and how far the bank has moved since. A question that was returned to review but is still served is called out first: players can still get it until a new pack is published.

```ts
import { PackStatus } from '@/contest/components/PackStatus'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. |
| `pack` | `ContentPack` |  | The pack in force. Without one the card says nothing is served. |
| `diff` | `PackDiff` |  | How the bank has moved since the pack was made. See `diffPack`. |
| `onPublish` | `() => void` |  | Shows a "Publish a new pack" button. It is the main button when the bank has moved. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<PackStatus pack={active} diff={diffPack(active, bank, keys, topics)} now={now} onPublish={scrollToBuilder} />
```

- A question that is still served but was returned or deleted turns the card red. An edited question is served in the version the pack pinned, not the new one.

### PackCoverage

Per topic: how many questions the pack serves against how many the bank could give, how they spread over the five levels, how many daily shows of the program use the topic, and how many weeks of those shows the served questions last. "Thin" means less than four weeks.

```ts
import { PackCoverage } from '@/contest/components/PackCoverage'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` *(required)* | `TopicCoverage[]` |  | One row per topic. See `coverage`. |
| `onSelect` | `(topicId: string) => void` |  | Makes each row a button. |
| `selectedId` | `string` |  | The chosen topic. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<PackCoverage rows={coverage(topics, bank, keys, activePack, program)} />
```

- The runway counts six questions per show (`QUESTIONS_PER_SHOW`). A topic with no daily show has no runway; an archived topic is dimmed and says so.

### PackDiffList

What changed in the bank since a pack was made, in four groups: questions that were returned or deleted but are still served, questions in a topic that was archived, questions that were edited, and questions that were approved since.

```ts
import { PackDiffList } from '@/contest/components/PackDiffList'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `diff` *(required)* | `PackDiff` |  | The difference. See `diffPack`. |
| `limit` | `number` | `4` | How many questions to list in each group before "and N more". |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<PackDiffList diff={diffPack(active, bank, keys, topics)} />
```

### PackBuilder

Making the next pack: tick the topics, read what is wrong, say what changed, publish. The server builds the pack from the approved questions, so the screen only chooses topics. An archived topic cannot be chosen; a topic with nothing approved is an error, a thin one a warning.

```ts
import { PackBuilder } from '@/contest/components/PackBuilder'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `topics` *(required)* | `Topic[]` |  | All topics. |
| `rows` *(required)* | `TopicCoverage[]` |  | The coverage rows, for the number of questions each topic would give. |
| `selected` *(required)* | `string[]` |  | The topics chosen for the pack. |
| `onSelectedChange` *(required)* | `(ids: string[]) => void` |  | Called with the new choice. |
| `problems` *(required)* | `PackProblem[]` |  | What is wrong with publishing these topics. See `packProblems`. |
| `note` *(required)* | `string` |  | What changed, in the editor's words. |
| `onNoteChange` *(required)* | `(note: string) => void` |  | Called with the note as it is typed. |
| `nextRevision` *(required)* | `number` |  | The revision the pack would get. |
| `onPublish` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called when the pack is published. |
| `busy` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner on the button. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<PackBuilder topics={topics} rows={rows} selected={chosen} onSelectedChange={setChosen} problems={packProblems(chosen, bank, keys, topics, program, active)} note={note} onNoteChange={setNote} nextRevision={4} onPublish={publish} />
```

- The button stays off until there is no error and the note has at least five characters. "Nothing changed since revision N" is an error: a pack that equals the one in force is not published.

### PackHistory

Every pack, newest first: its revision, whether it is in force, who made it, what changed, how many questions, and how that differs from the pack before it. A pack that is not in force can be restored.

```ts
import { PackHistory } from '@/contest/components/PackHistory'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `packs` *(required)* | `ContentPack[]` |  | All packs. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The clock, in milliseconds. |
| `onRestore` | `(pack: ContentPack) => void` |  | Shows a "Restore" button on packs that are not in force. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<PackHistory packs={packs} now={now} onRestore={(p) => restore(p.id, 'The new pack had a problem.')} />
```

- A restore is a new pack, not a switch back: history is never rewritten. It leaves out questions that are no longer approved, so a rollback never serves a withdrawn question.

### TopicManager

The topics as a list: the id (a tag, fixed once it exists), the name people see, and whether the topic is archived. An archived topic is hidden and no new pack serves it. A form adds a topic. Renaming changes the name only: questions are tied to the id.

```ts
import { TopicManager } from '@/contest/components/TopicManager'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `topics` *(required)* | `Topic[]` |  | All topics. |
| `onSave` *(required)* | `(topic: Topic) => void` |  | Called with the topic to create or change. The id of an existing topic never changes. |
| `counts` | `Record<string, number>` | `{}` | How many approved questions each topic has, by id. |
| `busy` | `boolean` |  | Switches the buttons off while a change is saved. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<TopicManager topics={topics} counts={approvedByTopic} onSave={(t) => saveTopic(t, 'Ada')} />
```

- Archiving changes no pack: the pack in force keeps serving the topic until the next one is published, and the status card says so.
